title: 伦敦资管Kevin Zhao：全球主权债收益率见顶，配置窗口已打开？
speaker: Kevin Zhao

segments.en: Nice to meet you. What's the compelling opportunity right now, as you look at yields pretty much ceilinged verb across the board?
segments.zh: 很高兴见到你。当前各期限收益率似乎都已见顶，你认为最突出的机会是什么？

segments.en: I think the sovereign government bonds now finally become attractive after being underperforming equity assets for a long time.
segments.zh: 我认为主权政府债券在长期跑输权益资产后，现在终于变得有吸引力了。

segments.en: So for example, from my Asia trip through four cities, I'm sure over 5% and 10 years now is one of the highest over the last 25 years and equity risk premier.
segments.zh: 例如，我亚洲之行去了四个城市，目前10年期收益率超过5%，是过去25年来最高的之一，权益风险溢价也是。

segments.en: So the inverse of the S&P 500 minus the 30-year tips is the lowest in 25 years.
segments.zh: 标普500收益率减去30年期通胀保值债券收益率的差值处于25年最低。

segments.en: So the chart speaks very loudly. So you missed the short pay attention to fixed income assets now.
segments.zh: 图表已经说得很清楚。如果你错过了，现在要关注固定收益资产了。

segments.en: How does the Fed calculus change any of that?
segments.zh: 美联储的政策考量会如何改变这一点？
